entries.name: rent-recreation-accept
entries.description: A height-0 sigmaProp(true) box spent at height StoragePeriod with an empty proof and var 127 = Short(0): output 0 recreates it at the current height holding value - storageFee, the fee goes to output 1. The rent path accepts; the input costs StorageContractCost = 50, not a script cost.

entries.name: rent-recreation-tokens-accept
entries.description: The accepted recreation for a token-bearing box: output 0 keeps the token (R2 preserved).

entries.name: rent-recreation-height-reject
entries.description: Output 0 recreates the box at height - 1 instead of the current height. checkExpiredBox is false and the verdict is FINAL: the trivially-true script must not rescue the spend.

expected.reason: org.ergoplatform.validation.MalformedModifierError: Scripts of all transaction inputs should pass verification. 00b31b46e9c7141f85ae38c3431db4888e76749de63f5dab3bcff5a864c31fe0: #0 => Success((false,50))

entries.name: rent-recreation-value-reject
entries.description: Output 0 holds value - storageFee - 1: one nanoERG short of covering the fee. Final reject.

expected.reason: org.ergoplatform.validation.MalformedModifierError: Scripts of all transaction inputs should pass verification. 15fa2a147abbbf2c94fbc877baee0d1125b84f911e316d3759cc98a684e48c28: #0 => Success((false,50))

entries.name: rent-recreation-script-reject
entries.description: Output 0 has the right height and value but a different script (sigmaProp(false)): R1 is not preserved. Final reject.

expected.reason: org.ergoplatform.validation.MalformedModifierError: Scripts of all transaction inputs should pass verification. 4ac7983d0a94d051e0da2a99b4fbcec4083ebbc12cf213becc662264e45f9d31: #0 => Success((false,50))

entries.name: rent-recreation-tokens-reject
entries.description: A token-bearing box whose output 0 drops (burns) the token: R2 is not preserved. Final reject.

expected.reason: org.ergoplatform.validation.MalformedModifierError: Scripts of all transaction inputs should pass verification. 27b67cca6eebbd2af4b5c19d7335955cf12b4f9014da52e7e77c32c0edf8b5c4: #0 => Success((false,50))

entries.name: rent-recreation-register-reject
entries.description: A box with R4 = Int(42) whose output 0 drops R4: an additional register is not preserved. Final reject.

expected.reason: org.ergoplatform.validation.MalformedModifierError: Scripts of all transaction inputs should pass verification. 552ae60f4623fc9d468f6209b5921bfc3b99c771e1f764cb243f0f27caccd76d: #0 => Success((false,50))

entries.name: rent-recreation-tuple-register-accept
entries.description: A box whose R4 is stored as a Tuple EXPRESSION (Tuple(Int(1), Int(2)), opcode encoding), recreated with the same Tuple expression in R4: registers preserved, the rent path accepts. Twin of the reject below.

entries.name: rent-recreation-tuple-register-reject
entries.description: The same box recreated with R4 as the equal tuple CONSTANT ((1, 2): (Int, Int)). checkExpiredBox compares registers with ErgoBox.get equality (ErgoInterpreter.scala:50-52): a Tuple node never equals a Constant node (values.scala:356, :807), so R4 is not preserved even though both evaluate to (1, 2). Final reject.

expected.reason: org.ergoplatform.validation.MalformedModifierError: Scripts of all transaction inputs should pass verification. ad988274202f8fe4e50cc86b057bc628b88b9af27452101394b2578fd6f85189: #0 => Success((false,50))

entries.name: rent-recreation-segregated-script-accept
entries.description: A box guarded by the constant-segregated sigmaProp(true) tree 10010101d17300, recreated with the same tree bytes: R1 preserved, the rent path accepts. Twin of the reject below.

entries.name: rent-recreation-noncanonical-script-reject
entries.description: The same recreation, but output 0's tree is encoded as 1081000101d17300: the constants count written as an overlong VLQ (81 00 for 1). It parses to the same tree, yet R1 is ByteArrayConstant(propositionBytes) — the retained wire bytes — so R1 is not preserved. Final reject. An impl comparing re-serialized trees accepts it.

expected.reason: org.ergoplatform.validation.MalformedModifierError: Scripts of all transaction inputs should pass verification. 29ce5e2dd9cf93e758dd20d1704ad409a31cd5c4192fa35821d566c7e7881e1c: #0 => Success((false,50))
